name: Mahou Shoujo Santa Claus
source:
University student by day, champion of justice by night… Santa Claus is coming to town!

Every December, university student Noelle gains the power to transform into Santa Claus. Her mission is to bring joy to the hearts of children all around the world by protecting the Workshop in the North Pole and delivering gifts to every child on the Nice list by Christmas. There’s only one problem: she’s stuck doing a supplementary winter course with her best friend Rudy to improve her grades... while trying to stop her mortal enemy Nez from sabotaging Christmas!

[From [url=https://tenshistudios.itch.io/mahou-shoujo-santa-claus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
白天是大学生，晚上是正义冠军……圣诞老人来镇了！

每年十二月，大学生诺艾尔都会获得变身圣诞老人的能力。她的使命是通过保护北极的工作坊并在圣诞节前向尼斯名单上的每个孩子分发礼物，为世界各地的孩子们带来欢乐。只有一个问题：她必须和她最好的朋友鲁迪一起参加冬季补习课程，以提高她的成绩……同时试图阻止她的死敌内兹破坏圣诞节！

[来自[url=https://tenshistudios.itch.io/mahou-shoujo-santa-claus]itch.io[/url]]
